swiss._comment: TCEC Swiss is Fork's PRIMARY target event (S30: AI-assisted engines enter only via the Swiss). Values are for Swiss 10 (S30). See docs/kb/competition.md, section 'TCEC Swiss (primary target)'.

format.double_rounds_note: Swiss 10 page: 13 double rounds; schedule.json: 624 games = 13 x 24 pairs x 2. The generic TCEC_Swiss_rules page says 11 (changed from 12 on 21 Nov 2025); the event page governs.
format.game_pair_note: each pairing plays two games with the same opening and colours reversed, back to back in schedule.json
format.pairing_system: TCEC Swiss Tournament System (deterministic, Monrad-like). Pairing order = score desc, then seed asc. The top unpaired engine meets the highest-ranked engine it has not met, subject to colour balance and to a full pairing still being possible (Blossom check); if none exists, the oldest rounds are dropped from the encounter history.
format.colours: double rounds: first-of-pair (higher in pairing order) has Black in game 1 and White in game 2
format.seeding: group seeding by strength: Swiss 10 used 10 groups (A-J), seed order A1,B1,...,J1,A2,...; round 1 pairs A1-B1, C1-D1, ...; previous Swiss winner is A1
format.rating_input: only through seeding: last Leagues standings and/or Elo after testing (TCEC bayeselo list, Elo snapshot), at the organisers' discretion. From round 2 pairings use score and seed only.
format.byes: odd field only: one bye per round, scored as a win, given to the lowest-ranked engine with the fewest byes

time_control.margin_note: UNVERIFIED meaning: Swiss 10 page notes a one-second margin in the actual event (written next to a time-loss report)

entry.invitation: developers apply on their own initiative by emailing a completed TCEC Questionnaire (v2.4) (Main Page; Questionnaire page; email address not printed: UNVERIFIED); organisers categorise and invite. Swiss 10: first categorisation 18 Jun 2026, invites sent 24 Jun 2026, submission deadline 1 Jul 2026 12:00 UTC, categorisation final 8 Sep 2026 00:28 CEST
entry.min_strength_note: UNVERIFIED: no minimum rating for the Swiss or playoffs is published; the 3000+ TCEC Elo bar is a Leagues rule
entry.categorisation_flowchart: https://wiki.chessdom.org/File:TCEC_playoff_categorizing.png (uploaded 2025-04-08): HCE -> Cat 1; NNUE with original data: many/important inventions -> 1, some -> 1 or 2 (TD), none -> 2; hybrid data: many -> 1, some -> 2, none -> 2 or 3 (TD); other data: many -> 1, some -> 1, 2 or 3 (TD), none -> 3. Cat 4 (AI) sits outside this flowchart.

categories.0: engines with a Leagues place not relegated from the lowest league (organisers' discretion, 'unless outdated'): placed directly; 32 in Swiss 10
categories.1: HCE engines and highly original NN engines ('highest originality'): 1 DRR playoff at 30+3 for 10 spots
categories.2: NN engines with own data but few inventions, or hybrid data with some: 2 DRR playoff at 30+3 for 5 spots
categories.3: NN engines on other engines' data with no notable inventions ('lowest priority'; e.g. Cinder, Stockfish/Lc0 data): joint Cat 3+4 playoff, 12 DRR at 30+3, for 1 Swiss spot
categories.4: created with major help from AI technology ('vibe coded', added 21 Jun 2026, revision 9185): one place in the Cat 3+4 playoff, decided among Cat 4 engines first; code open source and publicly viewable at submission and throughout participation; TCEC admins build the binary from the repository; not eligible for the Leagues in S30
categories.5: cannot be featured by TCEC (was numbered Cat 4 before 21 Jun 2026)

entry.spot_counts_note: x, y, z (spots for Cat 1, 2, 3+4) are set per event by the organisers depending on applicants; Swiss 10 final: 10, 5, 1
entry.categorisation_appeal: 24 h after TCEC announces final categories (chat/Discord), by email to TD, Kan and Aloril; TD decision final; no mid-season architecture change into a higher-numbered category; questionnaire must be kept current (Potential decision)
entry.cat4_route_s30: Cat 4 pre-stage (if several Cat 4 engines) -> Cat 3+4 playoff (12 DRR at 30+3) -> 1 Swiss spot -> Swiss. Not eligible for the Leagues however it scores; a separate 'extra gauntlet' is promised (format UNVERIFIED: no page or announcement as of 2026-10-23).
entry.cat4_preplayoff_if_several: Partly verified: revisions 9185-9410 (21 Jun - 6 Sep 2026) said 'at least 1 DRR at 30+3 as needed'; final text (revision 9411) keeps the single place but gives no format. Not played in S30 (one Cat 4 entrant). Future format UNVERIFIED.
entry.cat4_license_precedent: CatGPT (Cat 4, S30) uses PolyForm Noncommercial (source-available) and was accepted with 'open repository present'; whether an OSI license is required is UNVERIFIED
entry.season31_note: UNVERIFIED: Swiss 11 / Leagues S31 pages do not exist yet (404 on 2026-10-23); S31 categories, AI policy and deadlines not published
entry.s30_cat34_result: 3 engines, 72 games, 9-12 Sep 2026: Cinder 31.5/48 (qualified), CatGPT (Cat 4) 27/48, Serendipity 13.5/48
entry.promotion_from_swiss_10: top 32 -> Cup 17; the 17 engines without a Leagues place compete for 7 Entrance League spots (top 5 direct, middle 10 tiebreak for 2, bottom 2 out). Not open to Cat 4 in S30.

outage_only._note: Applies ONLY when the game server is interrupted (disconnect, lag time loss, other non-engine interruption). This is NOT adjudication during normal play.
outage_only.win_note: Swiss/Leagues numbered rules say both evals at least |10|; the prose copies on the Rules page say more than +10 / less than -10
outage_only.otherwise: restart from the reached position with time compensation
